mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the arm to the brain and spinal cord was most worthwhile because it brought the sensory and motor pathways together and explained their roles in movement.

leastWorthwhile.text: The individual pathway fittings were straightforward but repetitive; the fitting results added little explanation on their own.

surprise.text: I found it interesting that muscle spindles contribute information to our sense of limb position.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary: the named pathways and slots made their purpose clear, though the offered combinations made the sequence predictable.

continue.text: I would probably continue to see how the arm connects to the rest of the body, although I hope the next chapter offers more meaningful choices than repeated fittings.
